description: Soccer superstar Kylian Mbappé says there’s no “frustration” over not yet winning a Ballon d’Or – an annual award given to the world’s best player – but tells CNN’s Amanda Davies that this “can be a good year for me.” Despite not winning any silverware last season, the French forward became the World Cup’s all-time top scorer this summer and argues that the award should be given to the best individual player.

author: CNN
description: CNN gained rare access inside Israeli-occupied south Lebanon, where predominantly Shia Muslim towns and homes have been reduced to rubble. Three Christian villages have been spared Israel's demolition policy, but their residents are cut off from the rest of the country. CNN’s Jeremy Diamond explores the contrasting realities in southern Lebanon. Stream the full report on the CNN app.
title: 'It's not a normal life': Inside Israeli-occupied Lebanon

author: CNN
description:
Americans’ opposition to the war in Iran has hardened, according to a new CNN poll conducted by SSRS, with almost two-thirds saying the US is not winning the conflict and more saying President Donald Trump isn’t doing enough to end it. 

Americans have never held positive views about the war, and nearly seven months after it began, broad majorities say the conflict has hurt US interests, has not been worth the costs and that the president lacks a clear plan to handle it. 

CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten breaks down Trump's sagging numbers on Iran and foreign affairs. Also, CNN's Alayna Treene and Audie Cornish preview the challenges facing Trump as he heads to the United Nations General Assembly.

2:35 Enten on Trump's Iran approval rating 
3:08 CNN White House correspondent on the headwinds facing Trump at the UN 
5:34 How will Trump sell the Iran war during his UN speech?

title: 'Breaking records in the wrong way': Enten on Trump's Iran approval

author: CNN
description:
The key to Lebanon's future is in the south. For decades, southern Lebanon has been a bastion of Hezbollah support. Much of the region is now under Israeli occupation and dozens of villages lie in ruins. The Lebanese government is now trying to reclaim sovereignty over its own territory — from both Israel and Hezbollah. CNN’s Jeremy Diamond explores Lebanon’s potential path forward.

Stream the full report on the CNN app.
title: A reckoning for southern Lebanon

description:
“He has lost movement on the entire left side of his body.” Attorney Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch broke disturbing new details to CNN’s Erin Burnett about Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, the 28-year-old Venezuelan shot by an ICE agent.  

She told CNN that ICE jeopardized Perez’s life by transferring him 100 miles to a detention center with a bullet still lodged in his back, no pain medication, and bleeding. 

Also, CNN's Ed Lavandera has the latest details on the shooting and Perez's transfer back to a hospital.

description:
The Trump administration unveiled a new White House helipad on Monday, but Trump's decision to ban specific news outlets backfired during the ceremony. Because of the ban, the media organizations that make up the official press pool boycotted the event entirely. While some non-pool cameras captured the ribbon-cutting, the lack of pool audio technicians meant virtually none of the president's remarks could be heard.
